core_obligations: (1) implies (2): from the covering family U_i -> X extract finitely many quasi-compact etale opens W_{i_j} of U x_X U_{i_j} surjecting onto U (U is quasi-compact).
The fibres of p_{i_j} over W_{i_j} -> U_{i_j} are finite by the quasi-finite boundedness lemma.
Conclude the fibre of |U| -> |X| over x is finite via points-cartesian and finiteness over each U_{i_j}.
proof_roadmap: Finite subcover extraction; per-piece quasi-finite finiteness; reassembly via points-cartesian.
difficulty_reason: A two-step reassembly argument; the finite subcover extraction and the fibre reassembly are the substance.
